title: PVCELL-25/27.5 power-stage hand-off (calculated, not bench-validated)
topology: 2-level non-inverting four-switch buck-boost (FSBB), common negative rail, bidirectional

ratings.P_limit_rule: min(27.5 kW, 45 A x min(V_A, V_B))

switch_positions.name: S1
switch_positions.gate_resistor_note: per device, split outputs (UCC21710 OUTH/OUTL); R_off = datasheet switching-energy test value; R_on raised to keep the complementary device's turn-on ringing within the 0.85 x V_DSS rule (E_on penalty from the datasheet E-vs-R_G curve is in the losses)

switch_positions.name: S2
switch_positions.gate_resistor_note: per device, split outputs (UCC21710 OUTH/OUTL); R_off = datasheet switching-energy test value; R_on raised to keep the complementary device's turn-on ringing within the 0.85 x V_DSS rule (E_on penalty from the datasheet E-vs-R_G curve is in the losses)

switch_positions.name: S3
switch_positions.gate_resistor_note: per device, split outputs (UCC21710 OUTH/OUTL); R_off = datasheet switching-energy test value; R_on raised to keep the complementary device's turn-on ringing within the 0.85 x V_DSS rule (E_on penalty from the datasheet E-vs-R_G curve is in the losses)

switch_positions.gate_resistor_note: per device, split outputs (UCC21710 OUTH/OUTL); R_off = datasheet switching-energy test value; R_on raised to keep the complementary device's turn-on ringing within the 0.85 x V_DSS rule (E_on penalty from the datasheet E-vs-R_G curve is in the losses)

switching.pwm: centre-aligned, legs A and B on the same carrier

modes.buck: V_B/V_A <= D_max: leg A switches, S3 on, S4 off
modes.boost: V_B/V_A >= 1/D_max: leg B switches, S1 on, S2 off
modes.band: otherwise: both legs switch, D_A = D_max*min(1,V_B/V_A), D_B = D_max*min(1,V_A/V_B)

switching.dead_time_basis: REQUIRED for the device pair: the Miller clamp must hold before the earliest complementary turn-on (rev-5 AO3400A clamps, gen/gdrv.py) -> 181-586 ns at the gates with the rev-4 spread (gen/gdrv.py rev 5 (design_check record + constants via Python), sim/gdrv_miller.py: stretch 3.4k/100p gives 181-521 ns for MSC035; the gate-driver design must be re-sized). Firmware dead time 200 ns. Loss uses the maximum, ZVS completion the minimum
switching.min_pulse_basis: 600 ns complementary on-time + 2 x 586 ns dead time at the gates

body_diode_conduction.note: hard edge: the full dead time; soft edge: the dead time less the transition

gate_drive.driver: NOVOSENSE NSI6651ASC-Q1 (D-035), one isolated channel per switch position (4 per cell); bias supply open (D-035: UCC14241-Q1 documented option)
gate_drive.gate_drive_basis: sim/pv_design.py drive_requirements(): NSI6651 ROH 2.2 / ROL 0.3 ohm (sim/data/asia_drivers.md), device R_G,int and Q_G from the datasheets, R_KS 0.5 ohm
gate_drive.miller_clamp: rev 5 (gen/gdrv.py rev 5 (design_check record + constants via Python), sim/gdrv_miller.py): rev 5: AO3400A clamp MOSFET per gate at the gate-Kelvin pins; NSI6651 CLAMP drives them; release <= 65 ns after OUTH rises - required

miller_check.source: sim/gdrv_miller.py rev 5 (AO3400A clamp loop <= 1 nH), gen/gdrv.py MILLER_SIM
miller_check.result: die +1.41 V vs V_th(min, 175 C) 1.94 V: within the 0.5 V design margin

fallback_variant.source: NOT simulated with the rev-5 network: gen/gdrv.py rev 5 does not carry this device's rail (its AO3400A clamp FET would see 24.6 V > 80 % of 30 V at +20/-4 V); previous round (rev-4 PNP network) die +1.42 V

sc_booster.basis: gen/gdrv.py rev 5 (primary preset; the fallback needs its own booster sizing)

gate_drive.rail_range_basis: REQUIREMENT on the bias design (VDD-VEE 22 V): +-0.5 V on, +-0.3 V off keeps both makers inside their recommended drive and well inside the absolute limits

short_circuit.basis: no Chinese datasheet states one; MSC035SMA170B4 3.1 us typ (1200 V, 20 V), ROHM SCT4036KRHR 4 us - ASSUMPTION to be confirmed by the makers or a SC test
short_circuit.verdict: primary: rev-5 booster (22 ohm per device) turns off 0.62 us after DESAT detection (<= 1.0 us required); the internal soft turn-off alone would take 1.96 us. Fallback (MSC035, +20/-4 V): the booster is not sized for it in gen/gdrv.py rev 5 - open

inductor.tolerance_basis: catalogue A_L +-8 %; DC-bias curve fit spread not included
inductor.I_sat_definition: current at which L falls to 50 % of L0 (powder core, soft saturation)
inductor.conductor: solid round enamelled Cu 3.15 mm grade 2, 1 layer

review_corrections.MG-06_conductor: profiled (rectangular) litz or foil (round 10.3 mm2 litz with 1.1 kV insulation does not fit the 8044E window)
review_corrections.MG-07_insulation_class: H (180 C); hot-spot NTC at the winding centre drives the fan law / derating
review_corrections.asian_core: POCO NPC 26: better DC bias, ~45 % more core loss, no 80 mm E core (toroids only)

requirement.note: ELECTRICAL requirement set by the power stage; the construction (conductor, core, insulation, thermal) is the magnetics engineer's (sim/out/magnetics/design_pv_inductor.json, read by sim/pv_tradeoff.py when present)
requirement.hot_spot_basis: class H (180 C) less 25 K; module derating keeps it (sim/pv_module.py T_IND_MAX)
requirement.air_flow_basis: per-cell heatsink design flow (pv_tradeoff); the module model gives the real flow per inlet temperature

insulation_requirements_IC16.winding_to_core_basic: PD-free at 1910 Vpk (<= 10 pC), AC 2200 V rms 1 min, impulse 6 kV
insulation_requirements_IC16.NTC_to_winding_reinforced: PD <= 10 pC at 2387 Vpk, AC 4400 V rms 1 min, impulse 8 kV

asian_core_alternative.material: NPC 26 (catalogue mu 26, Bsat 1.25 T) or NPH-L 26 (1.0 T)
asian_core_alternative.data: sim/data/asian_magnetic_materials.csv (POCO 2026 catalogue p27-30: DC-bias fit, loss fit printed for 60/75u only)
asian_core_alternative.open: an 80/44 E-core shape in NPC 26 is not on file - confirm the shape or use a POCO toroid (NPC290026 class) with a new winding design

cost_usd.basis: ESTIMATES, no quote: core 2 x 8.0 USD (13.3 USD/kg Asian powder, as M1); solid round enamelled Cu 3.15 mm grade 2 18.0 USD/kg (LME 14.4 + drawing/enamel premium); insulation 4.0 (Nomex wrap, VPI batch, base); winding 5.0 + test 2.0; +10 %

inductor.construction: 2 x POCO NPC290026 (NPC 26, 74/45/35 mm) stacked toroid (as M1), 37 turns of solid round enamelled Cu 3.15 mm grade 2, 1 layer, core wrapped 2 x 0.13 mm Nomex 410 + polyimide, VPI class H, NTC at the bore-side winding centre in a reinforced pocket; insulating base with a centre clamp in the cell air stream

decoupling.requirement: low-ESL film within each leg's commutation loop so that the loop (cap-S_top-S_bottom) is <= 20 nH
decoupling.suggested: 3 x C4AQUBU4220A1YJ (2.2 uF / 1300 V, Ipkr 63 A, ESL 24 nH, C4AQ p.14) per leg
decoupling.basis: physical-leg deck (sim/spice/pv_dpt_leg_dec.cir): 1100 V, 72.4 A trip current, worst of on-times 0.6, 1.0, 1.5, 2.2, 3.0 us (decoupling-bulk resonance); rule: peak <= Ipkr/1.2 (VDMOS, Q_oss) and <= Ipkr with the Q_rr surrogate, ESL <= 8.5 nH so the 20 nH loop holds. Drawn 2 x C4AQUBU4100A1WJ: 56 A per capacitor vs Ipkr 28 A (PVR-03)
rejected: 2 x C4AQUBU4100A1WJ: 56 A per cap vs Ipkr 28 A
4 x C4AQUBU4100A1WJ: 35 A per cap vs Ipkr 28 A
4 x C4AQUBU4220A1YJ: nan A per cap vs Ipkr 63 A

inductor_current.basis: full scale >= 1.3 x hardware trip, rounded up to 10 A

protection.desat_basis: NSI6651 DESAT pin threshold 8.5/9.26/9.8 V, LEB 200 ns + filter 150-265 ns, DESAT to OUT <= 300 ns (sim/data/asia_drivers.md); V_DS(on) at the trip current, 175 C: SG2M040170HJ 3.1 V (margin 2.7x), MSC035SMA170B4 2.4 V (margin 3.6x); short-circuit withstand ASSUMED 2.0 us (no Chinese datasheet gives one)
protection.heatsink_trip_basis: heatsink temperature at which the hottest device reaches 125 C at full load, minus 5 K

heatsink_insulator.function: basic insulation of every TO-247 tab (drain = A+/B+ or a switch node) from the earthed heatsink (D-032, IC-07)
heatsink_insulator.overhang_basis: creepage 5.0 mm (PD2) and clearance 7.1 mm at 4000 m (insulation report row 'Basic HV-PE, switch node'): 6.5 mm surface + 1.0 mm thickness >= 7.1 mm
heatsink_insulator.Rth_basis: AlN 170 W/mK x 1.0 mm, two grease bond lines 50 um at 2.5 W/mK over 15.5 x 20 mm, + 0.05 K/W contact allowance; k values are handbook values (no pad datasheet on file) - confirm with the supplier's data and a thermal test
heatsink_insulator.mounting: spring clip on the plastic body (no screw through the tab hole: a PE screw would need its own insulating bushing and creepage), clip force per the device maker (TO-247: ~50-80 N, ASSUMED)
heatsink_insulator.tests: type test on the assembled heatsink: AC 2200 V rms 1 min, impulse 6 kV, PD extinction >= 1528 Vpk with <= 10 pC at 1910 Vpk (insulation report); at the claimed altitude's pressure for the PD test

switch_node_recurring_peak.basis: calibrated VDMOS commutation at 1100 V / 72.4 A, R_G,on 6.78 ohm (eff.), turn-on ringing scaled with the bus voltage
switch_node_recurring_peak.vs_bias_VIORM_1414Vpk: UCC14241-Q1 VIORM 1414 Vpk (IC-06): the bias barrier must cover the recurring peak; margin at 1000 V = 1.11

efficiency.note: power stage incl. gate drive, driver bias, sensing and the leg RC dampers; dead time at its 586 ns maximum; excludes fans/controller

control_plant.sampling: sample i_L at the carrier peak/valley (centre-aligned PWM) for the average

honesty: All values calculated from datasheets and assumptions listed in sim/out/pv_design/report.md; nothing measured.

bus_reverse_clamp.function: reverse-voltage clamp across each cell film bank: a bolted port-terminal short rings the bank below zero; without it the leg's two series SiC body diodes carry the freewheel
bus_reverse_clamp.connection: cathode to the bank's bus +, anode to bus -, all devices of a bank in parallel
bus_reverse_clamp.placement: on the cell's laminated DC bus AT the C4AQ bank terminals (port-A bank and port-B bank), devices spread symmetrically between the two capacitors; a clamp on the port board alone does not protect the cell legs
bus_reverse_clamp.decision: one clamp group per cell bank (2 per cell), not one per port: the bus from the port board to each cell bank (>= 10 nH even laminated) is in series with a port-board clamp, and the current stored in it closes through the cell's body diodes

DD600N16K_one_arm_per_port_on_port_board.assumed: 10 nH per cell port board -> bank, 5 nH per arm (both LOW estimates), 3 cells, port A, 1100 V

DD600N16K_one_arm_per_bank.assumed: 5 nH per arm incl. terminals (NOT in the datasheet; low estimate) vs the tolerated 1.50 nH; also 1.4 kg per module

alternatives_rejected.why_the_DAB_differs: the DAB clamps its own DC-link bank; here every cell bank is a separate bank behind its own bus

bus_reverse_clamp.branch_inductance_basis: bank terminals -> clamp group -> bank; body diodes <= I_DM 188 A up to this value with the leg branch at 15 nH (ESTIMATE); 6 nH per TO-247 incl. leads (ESTIMATE)
bus_reverse_clamp.reverse_voltage_basis: OVP 1100 V + bank ESL 9.5 nH x 6.3 A/ns

surge_worst.sharing: per-device values are the worst device of the group: mean x 1.2 (peak), x 1.44 (I2t)

leakage_W_per_module_at_1000V_85C.basis: I_RM 0.05 mA (25 C) / 2.0 mA (150 C) at V_RRM, exponential in T, linear in V (ESTIMATE between the two datasheet points)

bus_reverse_clamp.normal_operation: permanently reverse-biased (bus >= 240 V): no forward conduction, no recovery event, no switching loss; junction capacitance <= 8 x 300 pF (ESTIMATE) in parallel with the bank, not across a switch
bus_reverse_clamp.contactor_weld: not removed: the first current peak through the contactor flows before the bank voltage crosses zero

damper.function: RC damper across each leg at the device pins (drawn on PVCELL 03_power: R301-R304, C303-C308); damps the commutation-loop ringing
damper.per_leg: 2 x 4.99 ohm in series + 2 x 4.7 nF 2000 V C0G in series
damper.energy_basis: 1100 V, 72.4 A: hard turn-on 168 uJ + turn-off 8 uJ (the loop's Q_oss/commutation energy, nearly independent of the damper C)

required_resistor_rating.continuous_basis: 1.5 x worst per-leg power at the resistor's mounting temperature (heatsink-mounted thick-film power resistors; 2 x 1 W 2512 is not enough)

damper.in_loss_model: yes: loss group 'damp' (ngspice energy table per edge, V 250-1100 V x I 2 A-trip, interpolated)

worst_of: efficiency, worst_case_stresses, damper, decoupling, gate_drive.miller_check and the clamp's body-diode share are the worse of device_primary and device_alternate

device_primary.qualification: none stated: p1 lists only halogen-free / RoHS; p13 RoHS + REACH statements; p14 item 8 says to consult Sichain for high-reliability applications
device_primary.price_source: ESTIMATE: Sichain: RFQ; SG2M020170HJ 9.74 USD scaled by (R ratio)^1.26, the exponent of the Sichain 1200 V LCSC prices (13 mOhm 7.31, 27 mOhm 3.46, 33 mOhm 2.26 USD)

trip_band_costfirst.basis: band top + 1110 V across L(I) of NPC290026 x 2 (stacked, 0.5 mm spacer) for the response time; leg deck at 1110 V; limits L >= 0.35 L0, B <= 0.85 B_sat, I_DM, V_pk <= 0.85 V_DSS (calculated)
band top + 1110 V across L(I) of NPC290026 x 2 (stacked, 0.5 mm spacer) for the response time; leg deck at 1110 V; limits L >= 0.35 L0, B <= 0.85 B_sat, I_DM, V_pk <= 0.85 V_DSS (calculated)

cost_usd.basis: sim/pv_tradeoff.py cost_usd(): gen/data/prices.csv (largest break <= 1000 pcs) and labelled ESTIMATES (sim/out/pv_tradeoff/gate0b.md); port board, control, fans and enclosure not included
